news.h: Bears QB Caleb Williams won't 'spat' custom cleats out of principle, source says
news.d: Caleb Williams believes in his custom Caddix cleats, and won't cover the logo in accordance with league rules out of principle.

news.h: Source: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams fined again for cleats
news.d: The NFL fined Caleb Williams $23,882 for sporting Caddix cleats in Week 7, a source confirmed to on Thursday.

news.h: Seahawks' dominant defense faces challenge in Bears QB Caleb Williams and NFL's top rushing offense
news.d: Now it's Chicago's turn to face Seattle's “Dark Side.”

news.h: Can Seahawks' Rashid Shaheed become a complementary WR to Jaxon Smith-Njigba?
news.d: Shaheed was a big part of the Seahawks' Super Bowl run as a returner and earned a new three-year contract. But he has been quiet as a receiver since his trade to Seattle.

news.h: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 150 receiving yards, TD in Seahawks' win vs. Chiefs
news.d: Jaxon Smith-Njigba wasn't the main story heading into Sunday night's Chiefs-Seahawks matchup -- but he emerged as the game's biggest star, continuing his own historic start by catching nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Seattle's 20-3 win.

news.h: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, stifling defense help Seahawks hand Chiefs first loss
news.d: Seattle's bread and butter from its Super Bowl championship season -- Jaxon Smith-Njigba and defense -- was too much for the Chiefs.
